name: Glassmarch Prism Plate
description: A layered prism plate engineered to split incoming force.
specialEffects: Used in bastions, refractive shields, and light-splitting defenses.

steps: Refine raw stock for Glassmarch Prism Plate under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Glassmarch Refinery protocol before storage.
